subject: Commitment bands + model fallback checklist for renewal
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Joy Lee <joy.lee@helixpayments.com>
Cc: procurement@helixpayments.com
Date: 2026-10-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + commitment bands & model mix checklist

Thanks again for the time today, Joy — good discussion. Below is a short post-call recap and the specific asks we need to finalize a renewal offer that lines up with Helix's budget and product constraints.

Summary (from call)
- Current monthly token consumption (approx): 1.1M active inference tokens/week -> ~4.6M tokens/month (peak-aware)
- Target renewal: reduce unit $/1M via a committed band rather than on-demand tiers
- Important: production latency for payments flow must stay <250ms p95; some traffic is latency-sensitive (auth, decisioning), some can be routed to lower-cost models (logging, enrichment).

Pricing asks (what we need from Helix)
1) Confirm target committed range (pick one):
   - Band A: 3M-5M tokens/mo
   - Band B: 6M-9M tokens/mo
   - Band C: 10M+ tokens/mo
2) Confirm acceptable model mix for latency-sensitive traffic: do you require the high-throughput/realtime model for 100% of tokens, or can we route a percentage to a lower-cost variant? Example asks: 60/40 split (60% realtime, 40% standard)
3) Target unit economics: what is your internal target $/1M tokens for a committed deal? (e.g., $700 / $650 / $600)
4) Preferred commitment term: 6 / 12 / 24 months

Quick proposed structure we can move with once you confirm the above:
- Blended committed rate (example): 6M tokens/mo commit -> blended $650 / 1M tokens (with 70/30 realtime/standard model mix).
- Add automatic fallback: if realtime capacity constrained, traffic will divert to the standard model at a lower per-token price; billing keeps blended math.
- Overages billed at on-demand + 20% (or we can cap overage charges if you prefer a true hard cap — let us know).

Attachments: redwood-q4-blend-proposal-v2.xlsx (sample blended scenarios + per-model unit economics)

Next steps
- Joy: confirm items 1–4 above by EOD Tuesday and share any procurement constraints.
- We’ll produce a tailored quote and a short one-page PS summary for legal/PO.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Joy Lee <joy.lee@helixpayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixpayments.com
Date: 2026-10-19T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + commitment bands & model mix checklist

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side (I've pasted the call notes below):

- Preferred band: we are targeting Band B (6M-9M tokens/mo) given Q1 ramp expectations.
- Model mix: latency-sensitive transactions (authorization + fraud checks) are ~45% of calls. We would like realtime for auth/fraud (45%) and are open to routing the rest to a lower-cost standard model.
- Target unit economics: our finance lead flagged a target of ~$625 / 1M tokens for a committed 12-month term. They said $600 is aggressive, $650 is acceptable but prefer $625 if possible.
- Commitment term: leaning 12 months.

A couple of clarifications: 
1) If we commit to 7M/mo and we spike to 11M in a month, how does overage billing work? Can we apply a short-term buffer (2x monthly) before moving to the next band?
2) For the blended calculation, do you itemize per-model unit rates in the SOW so our finance team can reconcile to internal chargeback?

Procurement is copied; they asked that the quote include a clear per‑1M rate and an annualized spend estimate.

— Joy
Joy Lee
Head of Product Operations | Helix Payments
joy.lee@helixpayments.com

On Oct 18, 2026, at 3:12 PM, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time today, Joy — good discussion. Below is a short post-call recap and the specific asks we need to finalize a renewal offer that lines up with Helix's budget and product constraints.

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Post-demo recap + commitment bands & model mix checklist

Marissa / Lauren — saw Joy's answers. Quick internal playbook and proposed counters before we send the formal quote: 

- Their target: 7M/mo (Band B midpoint) and $625/1M target for 12 months.
- Proposed commercial: offer a staged blended band: 6M–8M -> $645/1M; 8M–11M -> $615/1M; 11M+ -> $585/1M (12‑month commit). Rationale: shows upside for higher consumption while respecting finance target.
- Model mix guardrail: require minimum 50% realtime for latency-sensitive flows to get the $615/$585 bands. If they dip below 50% realtime, we move to the next higher blended band + 5% surcharge. 
- Overage handling: allow 2x buffer on a single-month spike before band escalation; repeated spikes (2 out of 3 months) trigger re-evaluation at the next band.
- Attach a one-pager that shows line-item per-model unit rates so procurement can reconcile (we already have that in the attached workbook).

Questions for you: do we have pricing authority to go to $585 at 11M+ or should we flag approvals? I suspect discounts beyond $600 need sign-off from Lauren (rev ops SRP).

If you want, I can draft the specific band math and put both blended and per-model rows in the quote spreadsheet.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Joy Lee <joy.lee@helixpayments.com>
Cc: procurement@helixpayments.com, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + commitment bands & model mix checklist

Joy — appreciate the quick confirmation and the target number. We can do the following structured offer to align with Helix's finance target while keeping your latency SLO intact: 

1) Proposed quick offer (12-month term)
   - Band 6M–8M: $645 / 1M tokens (blended), requires >=50% realtime in production for latency-sensitive paths.
   - Band 8M–11M: $615 / 1M tokens (blended), requires >=50% realtime.
   - Band 11M+: $585 / 1M tokens (blended), requires >=60% realtime and a 30‑day forecast cadence.

2) Overage policy
   - Single-month spike: up to 2x committed monthly is treated as a buffer and billed at the committed blended rate.
   - If spikes occur 2x in a rolling 3‑month window, billing will escalate to the next band for the following month (we can also move to a true remediation call to re-forecast).

3) Per-model line items (for procurement reconciliation)
   - Realtime model: $780 / 1M tokens (standalone rate)
   - Standard model: $420 / 1M tokens (standalone rate)
   - Blended math in the attached workbook shows how the band prices map to a 70/30, 60/40, and 50/50 splits.

Next steps from our side
- I’ll attach a one-page PS and the updated workbook (attached). Please confirm you’re comfortable with the band structure and whether procurement needs the quote as a single-line blended rate or a two-line (committed band + model fees) layout.
- If yes, we’ll send a formal quote + DocuSign PO within 24 business hours after your confirmation.

If procurement wants to see a version that forces a hard cap on monthly charges instead of band escalation, say so and we’ll produce that variant as well.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
